title: Frappe ERPNext 14.47.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 14.47.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module. This flaw allows authenticated users with read access to certain accounting vouchers to delete and repost General Ledger entries, an action normally restricted to System Managers. The vulnerability arises because permission checks are skipped when creating and submitting Repost Accounting Ledger documents via a specific method.
